_howToEdit: This is the ONLY file to edit when events change. Everything else is generated.
After editing, run:  python3 tools/build-pages.py   (rebuilds the calendar, the
events page, the three cards on the home page, and the search-engine markup).
start   'YYYY-MM-DD', or null when the date is not set yet. Undated events are
listed under 'Dates still to come' instead of appearing on the grid.
end     'YYYY-MM-DD' for a multi-day event. Leave out for a single day.
time    Free text shown next to the date, e.g. '4:00–8:00 pm'. Optional.
whenText  Overrides the printed date, e.g. 'Spring 2027'. Use with start: null.
location  Venue and town. Optional but worth filling in.
link / linkText   Where the button goes. Optional; omit both for no button.
needsConfirming   true prints an amber 'date to be confirmed' note. Remove the
field once the Foundation has confirmed it.
Past events drop off the site on their own — no need to delete them, though you
can once they are well past.

events.title: Dine to Donate — Texas Roadhouse
events.summary: Come in for dinner, tell your server you are there for the Foundation, and drop the paper receipt in our box on the way out. Texas Roadhouse sends us 10% of it. We run one of these about once a quarter, and it covers a standing bill for the whole year.

events.title: Ride for Recovery
events.summary: Our biggest day of the year — a ride open to all vehicles, with a pig roast, raffle, auction and vendor fair. Riders, vendors and sponsors all welcome, and this is where our sponsors get thanked in front of everybody.

events.title: Narcan training and free kits
events.summary: About twenty minutes: recognizing an overdose, giving the spray, calling 911, and staying until help arrives. Free, and everyone leaves with a kit. We will also come to your business, church, school or civic club and run a session.

events.title: Golf tournament
events.summary: Our other major fundraiser. A hole sponsorship is the simplest way for a small business to back this work — the signs themselves are printed for us in kind by Minuteman Press.
